statement: The client has an Aggressive risk profile (risk class 5) with a long-term investment horizon of 20 years, an objective of growth, and a high capacity to bear losses. The proposed portfolio is suitable for this client. It consists of iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF USD Acc (SRI 4), iShares S&P 500 Information Technology Sector UCITS ETF USD Acc (SRI 5), and iShares Core MSCI EM IMI UCITS ETF USD Acc (SRI 4), resulting in a weighted average SRI of 4.15, which aligns with the client's risk class. The client does not have any short-term liquidity needs. Draft for advisor review and signature.
